correctness.rationale: The group law in odd characteristic gives a bijection between group endomorphisms and pairs (A,u) with A a 2x2 matrix and u a 2-vector, central multiplier det(A), and composition (AB,uB+det(A)v). Commutation is exactly AB=BA and v(A-det(A)I)=u(B-det(B)I). The proof exhausts A scalar 0/I/other, nonscalar with invertible constraint, and singular rank-one constraint subdivided by diagonalizable/Jordan; the latter two yield 2p-1 versus 2p compatible matrices via two nonparallel versus parallel lines. Matrix strata sizes s=p(p+1)(2p-3), j=2(p^2-1), g=p^4-p-s-j are proved. Symbolic coefficient and weighted-centralizer sums are p^6 and p^8+5p^7-8p^5+3p^3. Exhaustive separate matrix-fiber enumeration agrees at p=3,5,7; all group homomorphism laws and endomorphism-generator compositions at p=3 were checked. The proof, not finite computation, establishes the all-odd-prime statement.

originality.rationale: This is a centralizer-size histogram of all endomorphisms under composition, rather than the known classification/total number of endomorphisms, automorphism orbits of group elements, subgroup/element centralizers, Lie-algebra endomorphism ranks, or commuting idempotent subclasses. The new counting uses a substantive rank-one quotient and semisimple-versus-Jordan affine-line distinction. value.rationale: The histogram is a natural complete centralizer invariant of a finite noncommutative endomorphism monoid, refining commuting-graph vertex degrees, commuting pair probability, and center size; its seven distinct cardinalities uniformly for every odd prime show a natural stable stratification. The semisimple-vs-Jordan distinction yields structurally motivated nontrivial classes, and the formula is not an arbitrary finite cutoff, routine variable substitution, or recomputation of the known total number of group endomorphisms.
